findings.title: Button in .small-action will no longer be right-aligned
findings.body: Adding `@include flexbox()` to `.small-action` makes its direct children flex items. The existing `button` rule still uses `float: right` (line 309), but float is ignored on flex items, so the button will not be pushed to the right edge as it was in the float-based layout. Use `margin-left: auto`, `order`, or a spacer element to position the button.

findings.title: Header flex container may overflow because flex-wrap is not set
findings.body: `.d-header .contents` is converted to a flex container without setting `flex-wrap`. Flexbox defaults to `nowrap`, so header children such as the title, extra topic info, and panel will stay on one line and can overflow horizontally on narrow viewports, unlike the previous float-based layout that could drop/wrap. Add `flex-wrap: wrap` or appropriate responsive constraints if wrapping is required.

findings.title: align-items mixin has incomplete/invalid legacy flexbox prefixes
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin omits `-moz-box-align` even though `flexbox()`/`inline-flex()` emit `-moz-box`/`-moz-inline-box`, so old Mozilla box implementations will not receive the alignment. It also emits the non-existent `-ms-align-items` property and does not map modern values such as `flex-start`/`flex-end` to the legacy `start`/`end` values. Add `-moz-box-align`, remove `-ms-align-items`, and map values if legacy support is intended.

findings.title: order mixin does not convert values for legacy ordinal groups
findings.body: Legacy 2009 flexbox ordinal groups (`-webkit-box-ordinal-group`, `-moz-box-ordinal-group`) are 1-based, while the standard `order` property is 0-based and can be negative. Passing `$val` unchanged can produce incorrect or invalid ordering in browsers that use the legacy prefixes. Convert the value for those prefixes (for example, add 1 for non-negative orders) or avoid exposing the raw standard value.
